```{julia}

```

```{julia}
labelsize = 32
ticklabelsize = 28
one_fig = Makie.Figure(resolution = (800, cfg[!, :n_tasks][1]*300))
agentids = unique(states.bee_id)
taskids = unique(states.task_id)
for (i,t) in enumerate(taskids)
    t_df = subset(
        states,
        :task_id => ByRow(==(t))
    )
    ax = Makie.Axis(
        one_fig[i,1], #xlabel=L"\text{epoch}", ylabel=L"\text{accuracy}", 
        title= "$(t_index[t])", 
        titlesize=labelsize,
        xlabelsize=labelsize,
        ylabelsize=labelsize,
        xticklabelsize=ticklabelsize,
        yticklabelsize=ticklabelsize
        )
    for a in agentids
        a_df = subset(
            t_df,
            :bee_id => ByRow(==(a))
        )
        Makie.lines!(ax, a_df.epoch, a_df.accuracies)
    end
end
```

# plotting the agents


```{julia}
labelsize = 32
ticklabelsize = 28
one_fig = Makie.Figure(resolution = (800, cfg[!, :n_bees][1]*300))
agentids = unique(states.bee_id)
taskids = unique(states.task_id)
for (i,a) in enumerate(agentids)
    a_df = subset(
        states,
        :bee_id => ByRow(==(a))
    )
    ax = Makie.Axis(
        one_fig[i,1], #xlabel=L"\text{epoch}", ylabel=L"\text{accuracy}", 
        title= "Agent $a", 
        titlesize=labelsize,
        xlabelsize=labelsize,
        ylabelsize=labelsize,
        xticklabelsize=ticklabelsize,
        yticklabelsize=ticklabelsize
        )
    for t in taskids
        t_df = subset(
            a_df,
            :task_id => ByRow(==(t))
        )
        Makie.lines!(ax, t_df.epoch, t_df.accuracies)
    end
end
#one_fig[3, 1] = Label(one_fig, L"\text{epoch}", fontsize=labelsize)
#one_fig[1:2, 0]  = Label(one_fig, L"\text{accuracy}", rotation=pi/2, fontsize=labelsize)
```

```{julia}
)
```

```{julia}
ss = subset(
    act,
    #:task_id => ByRow(x -> x == 17),
    #:bee_id => ByRow(x -> x == 9),
    :epoch => ByRow(x -> (x >= 3000 && x <= 3500))
)
stats = combine(groupby(ss, :bee_id),
    :suppressed => (v -> mean(v)) => :frac_suppressed,
    nrow => :n
)

sort!(stats, :frac_suppressed)   # lowest first (the "exception" should pop out)
stats
```
